description: Source code for the Torch JIT runtime's graph executor implementation, including classes and functions for executing, optimizing, and managing computational graphs in PyTorch's JIT compiler.

classes.name: CaptureList
classes.description: Helper class for capturing tensors and IValues during autograd graph execution.

classes.name: UnpackInstructions
classes.description: Helper class for instructions to unpack saved tensors and IValues during backward pass.

classes.name: DifferentiableGraphBackward
classes.description: Autograd node for backward execution of a differentiable graph.

classes.name: DifferentiableGraphOp
classes.description: Wrapper for executing a differentiable graph, handling unwrapping and re-wrapping tensors.

classes.name: GraphExecutorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of GraphExecutor for optimized graph execution, including compilation and caching.

classes.name: GraphExecutor
classes.description: Main class for executing computational graphs, delegating to implementation classes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the graph synchronously with given stack inputs.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes the graph asynchronously with given stack inputs and task launcher.

methods.name: getPlanFor
methods.description: Retrieves or compiles an execution plan for given inputs.

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.description: Returns the current debug state of the executor.

methods.name: isOptimized
methods.description: Checks if the executor is using an optimized graph.

methods.name: debugFlushCompilationCache
methods.description: Clears the compilation cache for profiling.

methods.name: runRequiredPasses
methods.description: Runs optimization passes on the graph to prepare for execution.

methods.name: packGradient
methods.description: Packages gradient information into a node.

methods.name: getGradient
methods.description: Extracts gradient information from a node.

methods.name: getGradExecutor
methods.description: Retrieves the gradient executor from an operation.

methods.name: getDifferentiableGraphOpExecutor
methods.description: Retrieves the executor for a differentiable graph operation.
